description: Rank Transita's profiled cities on one dimension such as safety, healthcare or tech jobs, highest score first, optionally within one country. Scores run 0 to 100 and are editorial estimates built from the public sources the methodology names, not official statistics.

country.description: Lowercase destination country code, e.g. 'de', 'ca' or 'uk'. 'gb' also works for the UK.

limit.description: Most cities to return, e.g. 10. Default 10.

name: transita_rankings
title: City rankings
